builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: Fight up close with weapon hits, backed by Lightning Shield. Stormstrike at level 25 and a steady supply of Mana make the fights easy to follow.
builds.gear: Intellect first, as it adds attack power and Mana. Then Stamina. A slow two-handed weapon, or a one-hander and shield, works well.

why.Thundering Strikes: More critical strikes with every spell and attack.
why.Ancestral Knowledge: More Intellect, which means more mana and, with Mental Dexterity, more attack power.
why.Mental Dexterity: Your Intellect is added to your attack power, so weapon hits get stronger.
why.Shamanistic Focus: Shocks and Lightning Shield cost much less Mana.
why.Elemental Weapons: Your weapon enchantments, such as Rockbiter Weapon, work better.
why.Stormstrike: A strong instant hit that also makes your next Lightning Bolt or Earth Shock hit harder.
why.Flurry: After a critical strike you swing faster for a few hits.
why.Mental Quickness: Your spells hit harder using your Intellect, and it opens Rage of the Farseer.
why.Maelstrom Weapon: Weapon hits can make your next Lightning Bolt faster and cheaper.
why.Rage of the Farseer: A button that makes you attack much faster for a while.
why.Tidal Focus: Healing spells cost less mana and you miss less often.
why.Improved Healing Wave: Healing Wave casts faster, so you can heal yourself sooner.
why.Mindfulness: Part of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast.
why.Improved Reincarnation: Reincarnation is ready sooner, and your health is a little higher.
why.Water Shield: A shield that gives mana back as you are hit. Less waiting to drink.
why.Totemic Focus: Totems cost less mana, so you can drop one every fight.
why.Improved Ghost Wolf: Ghost Wolf, your run-fast form, casts faster and works indoors.

fight: Put Rockbiter Weapon on your weapon, and keep Lightning Shield on you.
Start with Lightning Bolt as the enemy runs to you, then hit it in melee.
Use Earth Shock whenever it is ready for extra damage.
Stormstrike
Use Stormstrike every time it is ready, then follow it with Lightning Bolt.
Maelstrom Weapon
When Lightning Bolt gets cheap and fast after weapon hits, cast it.
Water Shield
Keep Water Shield on between fights to win mana back.
Health low? Step back and cast Healing Wave on yourself.

builds.name: Dungeon healer
builds.suits: Keeps a group of five alive with Healing Wave and, later, Chain Heal and Riptide. Stay back, watch health bars and spend mana wisely.
builds.gear: Intellect first, then Stamina and Spirit. Look for items that add healing.

why.Improved Healing Wave: Healing Wave casts faster, so your big heal lands sooner.
why.Tidal Focus: Healing spells cost less mana, so you can heal for longer.
why.Mindfulness: Part of your mana regeneration keeps going while you cast.
why.Healing Focus: Being hit is less likely to slow down your healing spells.
why.Water Shield: A shield that gives mana back as you are hit or score a critical strike.
why.Mana Tide Totem: A totem that gives mana to your whole group. Use it when you run low.
why.Tidal Mastery: Your healing spells critically strike more often.
why.Nature's Swiftness: Your next Nature spell is instant. Use it for an emergency heal.
why.Purification: All your healing spells heal more.
why.Riptide: A heal that keeps healing over time, and it makes Chain Heal stronger on that target.
why.Ancestral Knowledge: More Intellect, which means more mana.
why.Thundering Strikes: More critical strikes with all spells and attacks, healing included.
why.Anticipation: A little more chance to dodge enemy hits.
why.Guardian Totems: Stoneskin Totem blocks more damage, which helps the whole group.
why.Earth's Grasp: Stoneclaw Totem is tougher and Earthbind Totem reaches further.
why.Improved Lightning Shield: Lightning Shield hurts attackers more when they hit you.

fight: Cast Healing Wave on whoever has the lowest health bar. Heal early.
Between fights, sit down and drink so your Mana comes back.
Lesser Healing Wave (level 20) is a fast heal for someone in trouble.
Water Shield
Keep Water Shield on you. It gives mana back as you are hit.
Riptide
Put Riptide on the one taking damage, then use Chain Heal on that same target.
Nature's Swiftness
Someone about to die? Press Nature's Swiftness, then Healing Wave.
Mana Tide Totem
Mana low in a long fight? Drop Mana Tide Totem.
